hero.title: Production vehicles for filming in Iceland
hero.subtitle: Campers, crew trucks, support vehicles and trailers. Set-ready, winter-proven and delivered to your location.

home.why1Text: Don't see what you're looking for? Drop us a line and we'll see what we can do. We're always happy to make things happen.
home.why2Text: All our vehicles and equipment come winter-ready at that time of year.
home.why3Text: Need us to bring things to you? We can deliver vehicles and equipment anywhere in Iceland.

about.title: The team behind the scenes
about.p1: Creative Filmmaking rents vehicles, machinery and all kinds of equipment to film and TV productions in Iceland. We started on set ourselves, so the fleet is built around what productions actually need.
about.p2: We've worked on projects big and small — features, series, music videos and commercials all across the country. That's given us plenty of experience in what each production needs, and we're always happy to help with planning of any kind. Drop us a line and we'll see how we can help.
about.p3: Every vehicle is serviced, cleaned and delivered set-ready.

contact.title: Let's talk about your production
contact.intro: Drop us a line about your project and we'll get right back to you — we can tailor an offer for your production. If there's something you can't find with us, let us know: we have an extensive network and can help sort things out. And you can always just give us a call.
contact.responseNote: We reply within one business day, faster during production season.

cta.title: Planning a production in Iceland?
cta.text: Tell us what you're shooting and we'll put together the right vehicles and an offer, no obligation.

footer.tagline: Production vehicle rental for film & TV crews shooting in Iceland.

tools.title: Helper tools

tools.privacy: All processing happens on your device. No file is uploaded or stored on a server.

pdfMerge.title: Merge PDFs
pdfMerge.desc: Combine several PDF documents into one.
pdfMerge.long: Add two or more PDFs, drag them into the right order and download a single merged file.
pdfMerge.failed: Could not merge the files. Check that they are valid PDFs.

imgToPdf.desc: Turn JPG, PNG or WebP images into a PDF.
imgToPdf.long: Add images, choose a page size and get one PDF with a single image per page.

locationMap.title: Location map
locationMap.desc: Draw shooting-location maps with pins, text and roads. Save and export to PDF.
locationMap.intro: Place pins (basecamp, set, parking...), text boxes and roads on a street map, aerial photo or your own image. Maps are saved to your account.
locationMap.exportFailed: Could not build the PDF. Map tiles need a network connection.
locationMap.imageTooLarge: The image could not be processed.
locationMap.shapeHint: Click to set the first corner (or circle center), move the mouse and click again to finish. Esc cancels.
locationMap.vehicleHint: Click the map to place a vehicle at true scale. Zoom well in to work with them.
locationMap.markerHint: Click the map to place a pin.
locationMap.textHint: Click the map to place a text box.
locationMap.roadHint: Click to add points. Double-click or Enter finishes, Esc cancels.
locationMap.label: Label

locationPhotos.title: Location photos
locationPhotos.desc: Make a folder per filming location and upload photos to a gallery.
locationPhotos.intro: Create a folder for each filming location and upload your scouting photos. Photos are saved to your account and shown in a convenient gallery.
locationPhotos.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the location, address, a script excerpt to read... (optional)
locationPhotos.empty: No folders yet. Create your first one above.
locationPhotos.emptyAlbum: No photos in this folder yet. Drop photos above.
locationPhotos.uploadHint: Drop photos here or click to choose
locationPhotos.uploadFormats: JPG, PNG or WebP. Photos are resized automatically.
locationPhotos.confirmDeleteAlbum: Delete the folder “{name}” and everything in it (subfolders and photos)?
locationPhotos.noSubfolders: No subfolders. Add one above to group locations.
locationPhotos.pinHint: Click the map to set a location for this folder.
locationPhotos.noPins: No folder has a location yet. Open a folder and click the map to drop a pin.

pdfEdit.title: PDF editor
pdfEdit.desc: Add text, drawings, white-out and images to a PDF.
pdfEdit.long: Open a PDF and add text, freehand drawing, white-out boxes or an image. You can also delete pages. Everything happens in your browser and the file never touches a server.

hints.select: Drag items to move them. Press ✕ to delete and pull the gold corner to resize.
hints.text: Click the page where the text should start and type.
hints.draw: Draw directly on the page with a mouse or finger.
hints.rect: Drag over the area to cover with a white box.
hints.image: Click the page to place the image.

pdfEdit.failed: Could not save the file. Check for unsupported characters in the text and try again.
pdfEdit.loadFailed: Could not open the file. Is it a valid PDF?

po.title: Purchase orders
po.desc: Log production costs per department; the production admin approves them.
po.intro: A light digital purchase order. Department heads log costs for their department, attach a receipt, and the production admin reviews and approves every order in one place.
po.noJobs: This tool is for department heads and production admins. You are not set up as either on any job yet.
po.scopeAdmin: You see every order on this job.
po.scopeDept: You see the orders of your department: {dept}.
po.scopeView: You see every order on this job (read only).
po.scopeLogAll: You see every order on this job and can log costs, approvals stay with the admin.

access.title: Purchase-order access
access.hint: Decide what each crew member may do in the purchase-order system, and which departments' budgets they may work in (the checkboxes). Default: department heads log costs for their own department, others have no access. Company admins always have full access.
access.addHint: Search the crew, pick a member and choose what they get access to.
access.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or role

exifMap.desc: Put GPS location points into photos on a map.

recce.title: Recce schedule
recce.desc: Build a timed tech recce schedule and download it as a PDF.
recce.long: Pick a start time, then set how long each stop takes and the drive between them. Every time is computed automatically and you get a clean PDF to send to the group. Plans are saved on your account.

callSheet.desc: Build a call sheet for a shoot day and download it as a PDF.
callSheet.long: Fill in the shoot day, locations, schedule and crew with call times. You can pull the crew list straight from a job in the portal and get a clean PDF to send to the group.
